title: AlertMatcherSetting
description: Which engine decides if an event belongs to an alert, one value for the whole cluster, per alert type. An alert must never be decided by one engine on one server and by the other on the next.

matcherMode.description: stored: the stored condition text decides and the plan is not evaluated. shadow: the stored text decides and the plan is evaluated beside it. plan: the plan decides and the stored text is evaluated beside it.

timestamp.description: When the setting was changed last.
